summary: Shadow/context-only deliberation: the measured tape remains risk-on and the risk radar is calm, but the confirmed US Q2/Reflation label is transitioning with low confidence (0.153): raw growth/inflation axes indicate Q3 for 2 of the required 7 sessions. Breadth and credit remain broadly healthy, volatility is normalizing, while liquidity is contracting in an orderly, non-stress-confirmed drain. The evidence therefore supports monitoring label instability and transmission frictions, not originating or escalating any position. Factor evidence is immature: only 10 panel dates, no Pair G records, no factor-attention history, and a survivorship-biased scorecard with no surviving tradeable composite. Kernel review also shows no engine is armed; US-board and radar signed-excess results are negative in Q2, while apparently strong board statistics based on unsigned MFE are not directional evidence. Two inert causal cards were registered as hypotheses for later grading, each with a 21-day horizon and explicit controls/falsifiers.
what_fired: US regime-label transition attention: confirmed Q2 is unsupported by current raw axes, which indicate Q3 for 2/7 confirmation sessions.
KDP options contradiction attention: an existing buy-lane name has rising five-day OTM-put skew; this is de-escalation context only.
Master-brain thesis-ledger hygiene attention: multiple open theses remain past their check_by dates without scoring, retirement, or explicit renewal.
Semiconductor thesis-family attention: several existing underweight theses coexist with broken semiconductor leadership and rotation away from semiconductors.

Registered hypothesis: in low-volatility regimes, negative 10-day Fed-net-liquidity acceleration precedes 21-day breadth deterioration; grade by hit rate >=0.55 with n>=35 and matched/shuffled controls.

Registered hypothesis: in high-volatility regimes, extended lagged cycle-state dwell is associated with weaker 21-day entry quality; grade by hit rate >=0.55 with n>=25 and collider/permutation/regime falsifiers.
contradictions_review: The confluence graph contains two current tensions. First, ticker-level demand/tape evidence opposes the briefing across 32 divergences, including IBM, VSAT, GOOG, and COST; this is broad interpretability friction, not a directional aggregate. Second, KDP combines existing buy-lane membership with rising OTM-put skew; sector history does not support treating bullish skew deceleration as an edge, so the legal use is de-escalation only. Pair G is dormant because the factor panel has fewer than 60 distinct dates. Open master-brain theses also conflict with current governance state insofar as many are overdue, and semiconductor underweight theses require review against current broken leadership rather than automatic affirmation. The world-state headline itself contains a meaningful tension: risk-on/calm tape and healthy credit coexist with contracting liquidity, restrictive real yields, and an unsupported Q2 label transitioning toward raw Q3 signs.
decaying_families: Risk radar as directional evidence: Q2 signed-excess kernel estimates are negative at 5 and 21 days, and the current calm state's measured 21-day pullback rate is below base; use only as context/sizing where authorized.
US-board directional family: Q2 signed-excess estimates are negative at 5 and 10 days and pooled out-of-sample results lose; it is unarmed.
Policy family: signed-excess estimates are negative across available horizons, samples are small, and the family is unarmed.
AI, stock-desk, and thematic-desk 63-day families: signed excess is negative, notwithstanding high nominal reliability estimates; all remain unarmed/vacuous.
Factor composite: non-tradeable, with investment, low-volatility, low-beta, and composite legs showing negative IC in an optimistic survivorship-biased scorecard.
Master-brain open-thesis ledger: overdue unscored items impair interpretability and should not be treated as current calibrated views.
deserves_operator: Review the US regime-label transition. Falsifier: close if raw axes cease indicating Q3 before seven-session confirmation; retain only if Q3 confirms or Q2 remains unsupported for five more sessions.
Review KDP's existing buy-lane/options contradiction. Falsifier: close if five-day OTM-put skew stops rising or KDP exits the existing buy lane; retain only while both conditions persist.

Reconcile or grade overdue master-brain theses. Falsifier: close when every thesis past check_by is scored, retired, or explicitly renewed with a new pre-committed criterion; retain if any remains overdue after five sessions.

Review the semiconductor thesis family against current evidence. Falsifier: close if semiconductor relative strength versus SPY recovers above its 20-day average and stays positive for three consecutive sessions; retain if broken leadership and the open underweight theses continue together.

Treat the 32 briefing-versus-tape divergences as an audit queue, not a fused directional view; determine whether they reflect stale briefing synthesis, heterogeneous ticker evidence, or a schema-level aggregation mismatch.
Preserve the factor ceiling until history matures: the panel has only 10 dates, Pair G is dormant, and factor attention has n=0, so no factor-derived escalation is supportable.
